player_prompt.intro:
I nih hi Player {player_id} ni e, HighSociety game (2-player version) ah.
Game flow:  Prestige card 10 te auction vek vek a ni.
Bidding:    Auction zana ah, money card 1-11 zinga pakhat thlang fel a, entir hrawh.
            • Higher bid chu prestige card a lo dawng a, money card chu a chawlh.
            • Lower bid chu a money card a nei reng.
            • Tie -> bid pahnih a let leh, prestige card chungah re-auction a ni.
Scoring:    Auction 10 zinga a tawp ah, **cash dang + prestige points** keng tel.
            *Net-worth* sang zawk chu a chak (a in ang reng -> draw).

**Action syntax**  →  card pakhat  '[7]' emaw '[11]' emaw bid rawh.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Must include exactly one [X] money card.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Chu pawisa card chu i nei tawh lo.

message.auction_result: P0 bid {bid0}, P1 bid {bid1}. Player {winner} wins prestige {prize} (total {total}).

outcome.draw: Net-worth {nw0}  exact tie ve tho a ni.
